sana: deploybot showing canary p95 spike after v3.7.2 rollout in us-west. autopilot is muted by operator-lock. can someone take lead?

matt: checking metrics. p95 +240ms on generator path, canary slice 4%. no 5xx.

ops-bot: snapshot: region=usw1 canary=4% p95_delta=+240ms error_rate=0.5% node_restarts=0

kehrin: i'm +1 for manual rollback to reduce blast radius. criteria: sustained >200ms for 4m, operator handshake, comms owner assigned.

sana: @kehrin you can be operator? i'll own comms if we revert (short blurb + changelog line).

kehrin: i confirm operator. planned command: `/deploy revert --to v3.6.9 --operator kehrin --reason "canary latency regression"`

deploybot: request received. validating prechecks...

deploybot: prechecks OK — artifact v3.6.9 verified, migrations none. initiating revert: demote canary -> restore v3.6.9. ETA ~3m.

kehrin: executed `/deploy revert --to v3.6.9 --operator kehrin` — acknowledged.

deploybot: revert complete. rollout state: active=v3.6.9 inactive=v3.7.2 canary=0%

matt: verified p95 returned to baseline ~80s after revert. opened REL-7210 to track regression and test long-context suite.

sana: comms sent to #customer-success: "Restored v3.6.9 in the affected region due to an observed latency regression during a canary; investigating. No expected data impact."

kehrin: leaving notes in the release ticket and will coordinate a targeted patch once root cause is found. ops please monitor for 24h.

sana: thanks team. post-rollback checklist: rel ticket updated, support notified, owners assigned. closing thread unless new signals.
